highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 3.119.4 rolls forward the 3.119 servicing line with platform fixes and bundled dependency updates.
highlights_body: It incorporates the unreleased 3.119.3 preview work, including Linux ARM64 and Ahead-of-Time reliability improvements.

breaking.title: Blazor API compatibility changes
breaking.body: The Blazor API diff contains breaking changes in this servicing line. Rebuild Blazor applications against 3.119.4 and update any code that no longer compiles against the revised view surface.

bullets.detail: Rolls the Linux ARM64 and Ahead-of-Time runtime fixes from the preview line into the stable servicing release.
Updates the libpng dependency used by the packaged native assets.

contributor_summaries.4Darmygeometry: HarfBuzzSharp and native-binding improvements for the servicing line

preview_summaries.v3.119.3-preview.1.1: The earlier preview introduced Linux ARM64 and Ahead-of-Time reliability fixes plus native dependency updates.
preview_summaries.v3.119.4-preview.1.1: Preview 1 consolidated the servicing work and refreshed the bundled native components.

harfbuzz_summary: Updates HarfBuzzSharp with the binding and native dependency changes included in the 3.119.4 servicing line.
